newsitem.title: UK: UK inquiry into Dunblane killings due next week.
newsitem.headline: UK inquiry into Dunblane killings due next week.

text.p: A report into the killing of 16 children and their teacher by a crazed gunman in the Scottish town of Dunblane is due to be released next week, a Scottish Office spokesman said on Friday.

But it is unlikely to be before Wednesday, the spokesman said. The Scottish Office expects to receive the report from the inquiry chairman, Lord Cullen, on Monday, after which it has to be reviewed and printed, he added.
The government has promised swift action on the recommendations of the Cullen report, which are expected to include curbs on private possession of guns.
But pro and anti-gun groups have been lobbying Lord Cullen hard for weeks.
